section.p: Consider a "Create User Account" chapter in an "Application Admin Guide" document where you want to correctly place the <info> tag in the task topic.
section.codeblock:
Create a user account with role-based permissions.

This procedure is valid for application version 3.2 and later.

Only administrators with the user:create permission can create new accounts. Newly created accounts receive a temporary password valid for 24 hours.

Log in as an administrator.

If multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enabled, complete MFA before continuing.

Navigate to Admin Users Add User . Fill the required fields: username, email, role.

The new user account appears in the user list and receives an email with sign-in instructions.
